description: This file contains unit tests for the strbuf module in C, including setup functions, assertions, and specific test cases for string buffer initialization, addition of characters and strings, and sanity checks.

methods.name: void setup(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const void * data)
methods.description: Wraps a function to test a string buffer initialized as empty, then releases the buffer and asserts its length and allocation are zero.

methods.name: void setup_populated(void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
methods.description: Wraps a function to test a string buffer initialized with a string, then releases the buffer and asserts its length and allocation are reset to zero.

methods.name: void assert_sane_strbuf(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Performs sanity checks on a string buffer, ensuring non-NULL buffer, null-terminated string, and correct allocation relative to length.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__static_init(void)
methods.description: Tests that a statically initialized strbuf has length and allocation zero, and an empty string.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__dynamic_init(void)
methods.description: Tests dynamic initialization of a strbuf with a specified size, verifying its sanity, zero length, correct allocation, and null-termination.

methods.name: void t_addch(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test function that adds a character to a strbuf and asserts buffer sanity and correct length/increment.

methods.name: void t_addstr(struct strbuf * buf,const void * data)
methods.description: Test function that adds a string to a strbuf and asserts buffer sanity and correct length/increment.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_char(void)
methods.description: Tests adding a single character to the buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_empty_char(void)
methods.description: Tests adding an empty string as a character (no change expected).

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_char(void)
methods.description: Tests appending a character to a populated buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_single_str(void)
methods.description: Tests adding a string to an empty buffer.

methods.name: void test_strbuf__add_append_str(void)
methods.description: Tests appending a string to a populated buffer.

ctags.name: setup_populated
ctags.signature: (void (* f)(struct strbuf *,const void *),const char * init_str,const void * data)
